How to Choose the Right Sofa Chair
Picking the right sofa chair design takes more than browsing photos. These five points will help you choose correctly:
Room Size

Check your floor space before selecting a design. Compact armless chairs work in smaller bedrooms and apartments. Wider wingback and club chairs need more room and suit larger drawing rooms and lounges. We can advise on the best size for your measurements.
Fabric for Your Climate

Velvet holds heat, which can be uncomfortable in Pakistani summers. Boucle and linen are breathable and more practical for year-round use. Corduroy is highly durable and hides daily wear better than most fabrics. Choose based on the room and how often the chair will be used.
Style Match

A undefined in velvet fits formal and traditional interiors. A boucle barrel chair fits modern and Scandinavian aesthetics. A spindle arm chair works in both traditional and contemporary settings. Match the chair to what is already in the room.
Intended Use

A undefined used for reading needs proper back support and a seat height that is comfortable to get in and out of. A drawing room accent chair can lean more towards appearance. A undefined for the lounge needs deep cushioning and wide arms. Be clear on how you will use the chair before you choose.
Colour Selection

Neutral boucle and linen chairs work across most colour palettes and hold their look over years of use. Bold velvet colours require a more deliberate room palette. If you are not sure which colour works, our team can advise via WhatsApp before you confirm.
